primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

wikipediaRead.locator: Article lines 107–113: lists eleven biblical men named Meshullam; item 6 identifies one of Zerubbabel’s two sons and cites 1CH3:19.
